home.title: JetScope Aviation Fuel Transition Decision Entry
home.description: A five-minute view of Europe jet fuel stress signals, SAF tipping-point events, EU ETS cost impact, and AI-assisted research workflows.

faq.meta_description: JetScope FAQ for launch readiness, source review, research workbench boundaries, scenario writes, and protected operations.
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.question: Is this state a product failure, or is the capability intentionally not enabled?

scope.title: What can JetScope review today?
scope.why: The stated review scope shows which decisions the product can support without overstating its reach.
scope.body: JetScope combines jet-fuel prices, SAF breakeven pressure, EU reserve stress, source quality, saved scenario assumptions, and research signals into one review workflow.

readiness.title: Why can launch readiness be not ready?
readiness.why: Separating configuration gaps from product failures makes the correct recovery action clear.
readiness.body: Launch readiness reports the actual environment. Missing management configuration, disabled AI research, database issues, or degraded source coverage are disclosed as blockers or review items instead of being hidden.

sources.title: How should I read degraded or fallback sources?
sources.why: A degraded source changes where its figures are safe to use and therefore needs review before citation.
sources.body: Source review separates live, proxy, fallback, unavailable, and error states. A degraded source can still be useful, but it should be reviewed before procurement or reporting use.

research.title: Why might the research workbench be disabled?
research.why: Disabled research is not evidence that the market produced no new signal.
research.body: The Research workbench does not pretend that AI analysis is live when the pipeline is disabled or credentials are incomplete. It shows the boundary and the next review actions.

scenarios.title: Can I save scenarios or refresh market data here?
scenarios.why: Protected writes need explicit authorization before a read-only state can be treated as a malfunction.
scenarios.body: Scenario writes and refresh operations are protected. Without the configured management token, localized FAQ pages and review surfaces stay read-only and link back to the primary workspaces.

limitations: These answers describe the current deployment design intent and do not change with live data; use the Admin page for the environment’s actual readiness.
The FAQ does not replace the current states and limitations on the Sources, Research, or Scenarios pages.

sources.meta_description: English JetScope source review surface for market provenance, fallback state, confidence, lag, and recovery actions.
sources.title: Source Review
sources.question: Which market inputs are not ready to use directly in a decision right now?

needs_review.label: Needs review
needs_review.hint_open: {fallback} fallback, {degraded} degraded, proxy, or volatility-marked rows.
needs_review.hint_clear: No source row currently needs additional review.

review.label: Needs review
review.hint: Fallback, degraded, proxy, or volatility watch rows

fallback.label: Fallback
fallback.hint: Rows currently using fallback or seed values

provenance.title: Source provenance
provenance.why: How much of the current snapshot is observed, proxy, or fallback decides whether a row can be cited directly.

coverage.title: Source coverage
coverage.why: Coverage status shows which canonical metrics have traceable inputs, so a gap is not read as a complete market view.

market_health.title: Market refresh health
market_health.why: Refresh-loop health decides whether the source table is a recent snapshot or has drifted from its expected cadence.

recovery.title: Recovery actions
recovery.why: Turning degraded rows into an operator checklist keeps a data-quality problem from ending as a passive status label.

matrix.title: Market input matrix
matrix.why: Each row connects source, time, lag, value, and action so market inputs remain reviewable before use.

market_health.unavailable: Unable to load /v1/market/health. Confirm the API is running and has a refresh run.

recovery.empty: No fallback or degraded row is currently critical. Proxy rows still deserve manual review before major pricing, purchasing, or disclosure decisions.

critical.label: Refresh and verify
critical.detail: Use the admin refresh path after configuring an admin token, then return here to confirm this metric leaves fallback or error state.

review.label: Review proxy assumptions
review.detail: Before high-risk pricing, purchasing, or disclosure use, cross-check the original quote, policy basis, and report wording.

normal.label: Keep snapshot evidence
normal.detail: Record generated time, confidence, and source state before using this metric in a material decision.

reasons.fallback: Live coverage is unavailable or fallback was used.
reasons.proxy: Proxy or derived metric; review assumptions before material use.
reasons.ok: Primary or official source with no degradation flag.

table.empty: No source rows match this filter.
table.no_stamp: Generation time is not a data timestamp
table.fallback_note: | showing fallback estimates because live coverage is unavailable

footer.source_ok: Source read model (coverage, confidence, lag, fallback, and review state)
footer.source_fallback: Source read model unavailable; fallback estimates are in use ({error})
footer.health_unavailable: Market refresh health API is currently unavailable
limitations: Source status describes input quality; it does not prove that each value applies to every airport, contract, or trade.
Proxy, derived, fallback, and degraded rows require human review before material pricing, purchasing, or disclosure decisions.
A fallback generation time is not an observation time, so it is not shown as the data timestamp.
